english:
Kills with explosive damage, <solar Solar /> abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, IKELOS weapons, <exotic Sleeper Simulant />, or <exotic Outbreak Perfected /> grant a stack of 'Warmind Charge' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 10 stacks. All stacks disappear when the duration expires.

Each stack grants 3 Grenade Stat and 3 Weapons Stat, reaching 30 of each at 10 stacks.

source.text:
2 Piece | Rasputin's Wrath

Upon scoring a kill with any of the following methods: 
Explosive Damage | Solar Ability Damage | Seventh Seraph Weapons | IKELOS Weapons | Sleeper Simulant | Outbreak Perfected:

Grants a Warmind Charge for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 charges.
All stacks disappear upon expiry.

Warmind Charges each grant +3 Grenade Stat and +3 Weapons Stat, up to +30 Grenade Stat and +30 Weapons Stat at 10 charges.
